title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: OCR scanning of images for risk scoring (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing treats government-cloud billing availability as unanswered, but Microsoft explicitly says document processing pay-as-you-go and its dependent services are not yet available to GCC organisations. The roadmap facts and principal controls are supported; the abbreviated billing route and several documentation qualifications also need correction.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans OCR detection of risky image-related activity in SharePoint, Teams messages and endpoints.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management will support the scanning technique of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to detect potentially risky activities that may lead to data security incidents related to images in SharePoint, Teams messages, and endpoints.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management correlates activity signals to identify data theft, leakage and security violations.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations.
